title: Hand-Restored 1800s Log Cabin | Creek + Fire Pit
description: Some places help you rest. This one was built for it. Promise Land is an 1800s log cabin restored by hand, tucked into 5 private acres (surrounded by 100s more) outside Leiper's Fork, Tennessee. A creek below, hills all around, and no neighbors in sight. Ten minutes from the village, a world away from the noise. Expect a long, steep gravel drive, little to no cell service, and a cozy footprint built for you. WiFi works, the creek sings, and the quiet does the rest.

We're the hosts of Promise Land, an 1800s log cabin we restored by hand on 5 quiet acres outside Leiper's Fork, Tennessee. A creek runs below, hills all around, and it's ten minutes from the village but a world away from the noise. We built this place to be somewhere people can finally slow down: long mornings, real quiet, room to breathe. We love sharing it with guests who need the same kind of rest we do.
